summary.intent: Use the GSD manager to discuss, plan, and begin executing all 5 remaining hardening phases (51–55) of the v1.1 milestone in parallel, using isolated worktrees per phase to avoid git index collisions.
summary.outcome: All 5 phases discussed and context captured; phases 51–55 all planned (21 plans total); phase 51 fully executed (4/4 plans, 419 tests green) and progressed through verify/secure/validate/simplify; CodeRabbit review found 7 findings, 3 applied via subagent with the session ending mid-flight on zeroization fixes.

repo: The dep parser misreads 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' — it splits into deps `49` and a phantom `1.1`, marking all hardening phases as `deps_satisfied: false` and producing empty `recommended_actions`.
Phase 50 had a stale `is_active: true` in the init query despite being marked `[x]` complete in ROADMAP.md — the SDK's active flag can be stale after a force-push.
The GSD commit helper auto-switches the working tree's branch to `feat/<slug>` on the first planning commit — two phases can't safely share one working tree when each triggers an auto-branch.
The `core.hooksPath` husky config points to an **absolute** path in the main tree, so any worktree's commits run the same pre-commit (pnpm lint-staged) and require `node_modules` to be installed.

The #683 auto-degrade fires when worktree HEAD diverges from `origin/HEAD`, forcing execute-phase to run plans sequentially in the current tree instead of spawning per-plan sub-worktrees — useful for planning worktrees that already have deps.
`cargo test -p cipherbox-fuse` does not compile `crates/sdk`, `crates/core`, or `apps/desktop` — cross-crate consumers of API changes can silently slip through the executor's test gate.
The `winfsp` feature cannot compile on macOS (`winfsp-sys` build script + `windows_core` errors) — Windows-specific Rust edits cannot be locally verified and require CI.

The FUSE Conflict-handling bug (#4/#5 from CodeRabbit) is pre-existing, introduced in `#352` Phase 23 — the 51 diff only reformatted its `log::warn!`; it belongs to the FUSE-durability domain (Phase 52).

The manager workflow's 'no nesting in background on Claude Code' guardrail is stale — `general-purpose` and `claude` subagents have `Tools: *` including `Agent`, so background agents can nest sub-agents in this harness.
The GSD commit helper can report `commit_failed` as a false negative — always verify with `git log`.
Phase 55's lib.rs decomposition must wait until phases 51+52 are merged to main; executing the refactor over a pre-51/52 lib.rs makes the eventual merge brutal.

Todo #15 (Faro transport wiring) was mistakenly bundled with HARD-02 (IPNS crypto-sig hardening); the redaction interceptor has no security value without a remote transport, and its acceptance criteria require Faro — correctly de-scoped.

code.finding: 51-03 changed `unwrap_key` to return `Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>`. Callers via Deref coerce fine, but direct field assignment to `root_folder_key: Option<Vec<u8>>` breaks. Fix: `.to_vec()` at the boundary; the Zeroizing temporary still wipes on drop.
Three byte-identical base64 decode-and-map-err blocks existed across the file; collapsed into a local closure in the simplify step.
S2 fail-closed verify runs on only 1 of ~10 `resolve_ipns` call sites (the folder-key descent path). Defensible since DB CID is authoritative, but the coverage asymmetry is a follow-up concern.

`root_folder_key` and `root_ipns_private_key` fields are plain `Vec<u8>` and persist un-zeroized for the session lifetime. The `.to_vec()` hotfix preserved this; the right altitude is typing these fields as `Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>`.
Reencrypt worker `spawn_file_meta_reencrypt` handles a `[u8;32]` key array that D-05 (exhaustive zeroization sweep) intended to cover but the executor missed.
Per-file IPNS publish records the sequence number as successfully published even on a server Conflict response — pre-existing data-integrity bug from Phase 23 (`#352`), not Phase 51 scope.

workflow: Parallel planning across phases works cleanly with per-phase worktrees: `git worktree add` the feature branch, run `pnpm i` in the worktree, launch the planner agent there. Three planners ran concurrently without collisions.
Usage/session limits can interrupt background agents mid-flight — track agent start time and worktree HEAD to distinguish 'just started' from 'truly stalled'; restart immediately at the reset moment.

Plan-checkers consistently find only doc-marker hygiene issues (Open Questions heading missing `(RESOLVED)`, `nyquist_compliant: false` not flipped) rather than plan-content problems — suggests planning quality is high once CONTEXT.md decisions are locked.
CodeRabbit CLI review should run *before* `ship` so findings can be addressed and the PR opens already-clean; `--agent` flag produces structured findings suitable for programmatic triage.

Execute-phase's `use_worktrees: true` + the #683 auto-degrade is a useful combination for planning worktrees: they naturally degrade to sequential in-tree execution, which is safer for heavy test suites and avoids nested per-plan worktree dep-installation overhead.

The verify step for backend crypto phases has no user-facing flow to walk through — its value is build verification (`cargo check --workspace`) and confirming all automated suites are green; the formal UAT.md script is ceremony in this context.

Dissolving a spent worktree (`git worktree remove`) and checking out its branch in the main tree before interactive ship gates (verify/secure/validate/simplify/PR) keeps those steps in the user's session context rather than in a headless agent.

friction: The dep parser split 'Phase 49 (v1.1 baseline)' into deps `49` + phantom `1.1` — caused all hardening phases to show `deps_satisfied: false` and `recommended_actions: []`, requiring manual override to proceed.

Background planner for Phase 51 was initially launched without `isolation: 'worktree'` — it inherited the shared main tree, which would have collided with Phase 52's auto-branch on first context commit. Required manual worktree creation, branch checkpoint, and restart.
The manager workflow's conservative 'no nesting in Claude Code background agents' guardrail is incorrect for this harness — caused an unnecessary debate and delayed parallel execution.
Session/usage limit interrupted the Phase 51 planner exactly mid-pipeline (after `pnpm i`, before research) — required restart at the 20:40 reset moment.

The executor's `cargo test -p cipherbox-fuse` gate missed the desktop crate consumer — caused a `vault.rs:210` compile error (`Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>` vs `Vec<u8>`) that only surfaced in the verify step's `cargo check --workspace`.
The 51 executor left stranded `cargo fmt` reformatting of 39 out-of-scope files in commits, requiring a `git checkout --` cleanup pass.
Worktrees have no `node_modules` by default but share the main tree's absolute husky hooks path — pre-commit hooks fail until `pnpm i` runs in the worktree.
The winfsp-gated Windows FUSE path (`windows/operations.rs`) cannot be compiled or tested on macOS, making zeroization fix #2 unverifiable locally and requiring a CI-trust deferral.
The GSD commit helper false-negative on `commit_failed` required an extra `git log` verification step after every commit.
open_items: Phase 51 ship loop incomplete: CodeRabbit zeroization fixes (#3/#6/#7) mid-flight in subagent; after those land, need to ship via `/gsd:ship` and run `resolve-pr-reviews`.
Transient `[u8;32]` decrypt key arrays in macOS `operations.rs` (#1) and Windows `windows/operations.rs` (#2) not zeroized — deferred pending CI-gated fix on both platforms simultaneously.
FUSE Conflict-handling data-integrity bug (#4/#5 from CodeRabbit) — per-file IPNS publish records sequence as success on server Conflict; pre-existing from Phase 23, belongs to Phase 52 scope.

SDK-state `root_folder_key` / `root_ipns_private_key` in `crates/sdk/src/state.rs` should be typed `Zeroizing<Vec<u8>>` — the `.to_vec()` hotfix preserved the regression; right altitude is changing the field type.
Phase 51 Rust S2 verify coverage: only 1 of ~10 `resolve_ipns` call sites has fail-closed verification (the folder-key descent); other paths are unguarded.
Folder-key cache in `lib.rs` stores un-zeroized `Vec<u8>` with a misleading 'cleared when dropped' comment — follow-up zeroization pass needed.
Web/sdk-core IPNS service verify/resolve kept in lockstep manually — potential dedup opportunity.
Todo #15 (Faro transport wiring + logger `redact()` interceptor) deferred to a future observability phase; removed from Phase 51 CONTEXT, ROADMAP, and REQUIREMENTS.
Phases 52, 53, 54 ready to execute in their worktrees (5, 4, 4 plans respectively).
Phase 55 execution must be held until Phases 51+52 merge to main so `lib.rs` decomposition rebases cleanly over the functional changes.
Worktrees p52–p55 still exist with planned branches — need cleanup or execution.
3 stale `release-as` pins (`packages/core`, `packages/crypto`, `crates/core`) to be cleared in Phase 53 execution.
Phase 53 safety-net: `cancel-in-progress: true → false` and fetch+rebase discipline to be codified in Phase 53 execution (plan 53-04).
